title: ICE won't pause enforcement in NY after Bronx shooting, DHS' Mullin says
summary: Following a recent shooting incident in the Bronx, New York Governor Kathy Hochul has urged Homeland Security Secretary Mullin and President Donald Trump to suspend ICE operations within the state. This request highlights ongoing tensions regarding immigration enforcement and public safety. Despite these appeals, DHS officials have indicated that ICE will continue its enforcement activities as planned, raising concerns among local communities about the implications for immigrant residents.
